bio.text: Kendra Johnson has represented the 5th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2018.
Johnson was born and raised in the city of Chester and holds a master's degree in Human Services from Lincoln University.
Johnson previously served as executive director of a nonprofit overseeing 21 programs in Delaware and Pennsylvania, and is Director of Community Relations for Conexio Care.
Johnson serves on the board of The Ability Network of Delaware.
